description.zh: 频道所属的应用 ID。由大小写字母、数字、下划线、短划线（-）组成，最大 64 字符。
description.en: The ID of the application to which the channel belongs. The ID can contain uppercase letters, lowercase letters, digits, underscores (\_), and hyphens (-). The maximum length is 64 characters.

description.zh: 待转码用户所属的频道 ID。由大小写字母、数字、下划线、短划线（-）组成，最大 64 字符。
description.en: The ID of the channel to which the user to be transcoded belongs. The ID can contain uppercase letters, lowercase letters, digits, underscores (\_), and hyphens (-). The maximum length is 64 characters.
The parameters for the input stream subscription.

description.zh:
空闲超时时间，当任务处于空闲状态（订阅不到指定主播流）的时长超过一定时间会自动停止。
单位为秒，范围须在[10,14400]内，即最大 4 小时，默认为 300 秒。
description.en: The idle timeout period in seconds. If a task cannot subscribe to the specified streamer's stream and remains idle for longer than this period, the task automatically stops. The value must be an integer from 10 to 14,400. The default value is 300.
The parameters for the transcoded output.

description.zh: 转码流转推到的频道ID。由大小写字母、数字、下划线、短划线（-）组成，最大 64 字符。（暂不支持转推到不同的频道，设置无效）
description.en: The ID of the channel to which the transcoded stream is pushed. The ID can contain uppercase letters, lowercase letters, digits, underscores (\_), and hyphens (-). The maximum length is 64 characters. (Pushing streams to a different channel is not supported. This setting is invalid.)

description.zh:
转码模板名。取值：

- alimcopy
- lld
- lsd
- lhd
- lud
description.en:
The name of the transcoding template. Valid values:

- alimcopy

- lld

- lsd

- lhd

- lud

description.zh: 转码流转推到频道的用户ID，需保证与频道内其它用户ID不同。
description.en: The user ID for the transcoded stream in the destination channel. This ID must be unique within the channel.

description.zh: 转码流转推到频道所需的用户Token，详见[Token鉴权](https://help.aliyun.com/zh/live/token-based-authentication)。
description.en: The token required to push the transcoded stream to the channel. For more information, see [Token-based authentication](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/apsaravideo-live/latest/token-based-authentication).
